notes.title: Coffee & Boobs: Grand Gala — DLC is available now! 💃🔥
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/29d365b753c2814f809ced9bf0bdf2fa478a32c2.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3816810/CoffeeBoobs_Grand_Gala/
[i]Ready to reunite with the charming staff of “Serenity” Café and open a fresh chapter in their passionate story?[/i]

[h2]What’s waiting for you in the Grand Gala?[/h2]
[h3]✨ New Characters[/h3]
The delightful crew of “Serenity” is ready for new adventures! Joining them are a sultry MILF — a former villainess — and a complex, yandere femboy with a fiery personality.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/1948e908391b52d213fb11668fe4bc03f61c96a6.png[/img]

[h3]💋 Animated H-Scenes[/h3]
Continue the spicy stories of your favorite characters, and don’t miss the chance to explore brand-new encounters in full animated glory!

[h3]💎 New Challenges[/h3]
Host banquets for elite guests, skillfully assigning roles among your coworkers. The success of the event and the fate of the characters is in your hands.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/f2de984e2feb3c5fc5ee110fed2ff138b78be03c.png[/img][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/30462b3d8518946a6cfec516aab45d887e240367.png[/img][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44510355/0b7795508d3f1048dd0cd2573a0ed98c8f957557.png[/img]

Tables are set and beds are made. Glasses are polished and outfits are pressed. An unforgettable party and a sleepless night await you. 

[h1]The Grand Gala begins![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3816810/CoffeeBoobs_Grand_Gala/
